user.description: The system user account to run Jameica under.

group.description: The system group account to run Jameica under.

start_mode.description: Jameica start mode: 'client' (with UI) or 'server' (headless). Corresponds to -c or -d flags.

java_home.description: Path to the JAVA_HOME directory for the Java runtime environment.

java_opts.description: Additional Java options passed via JAVA_OPTS, e.g., memory limits or proxy settings.

working_directory.description: The directory used as the user home directory for Jameica (-f option).
